records.name: Saudi Arabia
records.summary_text:
Saudi Arabia is among the most dangerous countries in the world for a transgender person to be discovered in. Under its uncodified Sharia legal system, same-sex conduct is punishable in theory by death, flogging, or long imprisonment, and transgender expression itself is criminalised through "imitation of the opposite sex" and public-morality provisions that police and the morality police enforce with broad discretion. There is no legal gender recognition and gender-affirming care is banned.

Enforcement is documented and brutal: trans women have been arrested, detained, and tortured o

records.name: Afghanistan
records.summary_text: Afghanistan under the Taliban — the nation's current ruling movement — is the most hostile environment on this map for a transgender person. A 2024 Morality Law obliges the regime's virtue police to prevent "homosexuality" and "lesbianism", including "even if with one's own spouse"; the ruling movement applies the death penalty for same-sex relations under its interpretation of Sharia; and documented practice against LGBTIQ people includes beatings, sexual violence in detention, forced confessions, and house-to-house searches. Transgender residents report living in hiding, in windowless roo
